name: single leg step up on bench
description: A step-up onto a bench using one leg at a time. It builds strength in the thighs and glutes and helps balance.
instructions: Stand facing a sturdy bench and place one foot fully on top.
Lean slightly forward and press through that heel.
Step up until the leg is straight and you stand tall.
Lower yourself slowly back down with control.
Avoid pushing off the trailing foot.
Complete your reps, then switch legs.
